text: The village elders were not fools.
They decreed that no words spoken on dry land would suffice.
On the morning of the new moon, both entire villages gathered at the sacred river crossing of the Bintang tributary, where crystal water flowed over smooth black river stones.
Here, ancestral law held that anyone who swore a false oath while standing ankle-deep in the current would be struck dumb and swallowed by the sinking mud.
As Koochi stepped into the cool water, his knees trembled violently.
Hundreds of eyes watched his lips.
